selection.selection_rule: Exact user-endorsed asset, appearance, native retention, semantics, additions, display gates, structure, physics, recency; unknown is not passed.

interactions.name: open_close
interactions.action: Within the single host dynamics run target 0, pi/4, pi/2, then 0 radians; inspect native surface ownership and connection at all three poses.
interactions.expected: Lid front rises about rear horizontal axis; cap inherits lid motion. Actual visible surfaces remain attached; endpoints within declared host tolerance.

interactions.name: press_release
interactions.action: Press 0 to 0.002 m and unload; record actual body displacement and recovery.
interactions.expected: Disk moves inward relative to stationary bezel and returns; no claim of observed latch coupling.

interactions.name: front_full_turn
interactions.action: Use unwrapped position targets 0, pi, 2*pi and hold over bounded time, with finite force cap and no angular actuator ctrlrange.
interactions.expected: Real joint qpos traverses at least one full turn; inspect intermediate visible textured disk motion, not endpoint equivalence only.

interactions.name: cap_full_turn
interactions.action: Use unwrapped 0, pi, 2*pi targets with lid closed and check attachment once with lid open; no mechanical stops.
interactions.expected: Top cap rotates relative to lid and follows lid when opening. Preserve all native PBR; motion result remains unverified until host attempt.

review_requirements: At lid_open minimum, midpoint and maximum, verify the upper native surface stays attached to the base pivot and endpoints remain within declared tolerance.
Drive button_press from zero to its declared displacement and unload; verify relative motion and return toward neutral.
Command dial_spin through zero, pi and 2*pi with limited=false and verify unwrapped motion and visible intermediate rotation.
Command cap_spin through zero, pi and 2*pi with the lid closed, then verify attachment at a representative open pose.
Verify each native triangle has one visible owner and UV/material assignments survive export for the declared bodies.

interaction_coverage.label: Open upper assembly
interaction_coverage.reason: Input seam and lateral/rear native seam support an upper moving assembly. Hidden rear hinge is an editable approximate prior; keep top-mounted parts attached through hierarchy.

interaction_coverage.label: Press front control
interaction_coverage.reason: Distinct disk and annular bezel support a short axial push hypothesis. Two millimetres is constrained control travel prior, not measured displacement.

interaction_coverage.label: Rotate front circular control
interaction_coverage.reason: Concentric front disk mount permits a useful rotary-control hypothesis; no visible mechanical angular stop. Rotation is an approximate mechanism, not recovered product truth.

interaction_coverage.label: Rotate raised top assembly
interaction_coverage.reason: Concentric raised mount and radial ribs support a rotary cap hypothesis with no observed stop; fixed vent remains a plausible alternative.

interaction_coverage.label: Top-panel touch graphics
interaction_coverage.reason: Surface graphics have no evidenced geometric travel. Retained as native graphics; electronic touch functionality is outside mechanical preview.

approximation_gaps.reason: Preserve all source faces without cap repairs; hidden interior is absent or uncertain. Before build export, cheap 0/45/90-degree hierarchy checks must report exposed seams or disconnected attachment; do not silently claim recovered interior or add unapproved geometry.

Use simple box/cylinder proxies with positive inertia and native extent coverage; round shell, bezel clearances and hidden cavity are approximations. Record contact under frozen tolerance policy, no blanket collision suppression or tiny-range reduction.
